name: imap-plugin
description: Connect Codex to generic IMAP mailboxes with read tools and paid mail actions.

interface.shortDescription: Read IMAP mailboxes and enable paid mail actions from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect generic IMAP mailboxes to Codex for folder listing, message search, message reading, attachment access, and subscriber-controlled SMTP/IMAP mail actions without requiring a provider-specific mail connector.
defaultPrompt: Enable SMTP sending for IMAP Mailboxes.
